universe.description: All S&P 500 companies except Berkshire Hathaway (no company-wide career site). Companies with two share classes count once. The first 20 are the pilot companies in index-weight order; the rest follow alphabetically.
universe.note: Constituents change a few times a year; refresh this list before each quarterly run.

phenom.note: Phenom-hosted career sites share one firewall: when many are read at once it refuses all of them together (seen 2026-10-17), so only a few run at a time.
